reason: A web-managed cron scheduler that persists task state, executes configured host shell commands, records logs, and emits in-application notifications; human review is warranted because shell execution is enabled by default without command confirmation or an allowlist.

summaries.zh: 通过 Web 侧边栏管理基于 cron 的定时任务，支持执行主机 shell 命令、站内通知、任务持久化和执行日志。
summaries.en: A web sidebar plugin for managing cron-scheduled tasks with host shell execution, in-app notifications, persistent task storage, and execution logs.

capabilities: Schedules tasks using five-field cron expressions
Executes configured shell commands on the host machine
Creates in-application notifications and execution logs
Provides a web sidebar for task management
Persists task definitions and logs in local storage
